# Nomadar to Take Part in the 2026 LD Micro Main Event


by[Press](https://nomadar.com/author/press/)


| Oct 7, 2026


|[News](https://nomadar.com/category/news/) |[0 comments](https://nomadar.com/nomadar-to-take-part-in-the-2026-ld-micro-main-event/#respond)


Nomadar is heading to Los Angeles. On October 20-21, 2026, Nomadar Corp. (NASDAQ: NOMA) will take part in the 20th Annual LD Micro Main Event, held at the Luxe Sunset Blvd. Hotel. Joaquin Martin, Nomadar CEO Americas and Board Director, will represent us.


Events like this give us a chance to explain what we do in our own words. We are a Nasdaq-listed company that works where sports, tourism, technology, health and experiential infrastructure meet. We build and run platforms that connect audiences around the world through high-performance training, youth development, digital education, international programs, sports tourism and large-scale experiential projects.


Mr. Martin will present on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, at 11:30 a.m. PT. The presentation will be shown live by webcast at[https://ldmicroevents.com/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=ov6KWzdkxYPGEr8DRRIlDylromLpfRFEYmle0eqfcOGehlu-UzHp1JjDwSb6-dHVSGJ_yaWhY_U0J3woJ1VSG6jD5RSIOg1ChLADlMrIyPs=) (Track 3).


Mr. Martin will also be available for one-on-one meetings with investors on Tuesday, October 20, and Wednesday, October 21. Investors who want to meet him can send a request through the LD Micro conference platform or by email toNOMAIR@allianceadvisors.com .


It is a good chance to see up close where Nomadar is going.
